_about: Sample photos for a fresh local site: `npm run photos` uploads each file in seed/photos/ to the media library and puts it in its slot. Production gets them inside the site package, not from here. Stock photos are from Unsplash (free to use, no attribution required); chapter photos are DSA Fort Worth's own; the -hogue photos are by Hogue, a local photographer. Every file here is resized and stripped of EXIF metadata (GPS, camera) before upload, because EmDash serves the original upload publicly. Full-size originals are kept out of git, in originals/ on the maintainer's machine.
